attributes.title: Long Take
attributes.lede: Nothing on this screen changes. Every frame of it is the camera.

lesson.concept: Two cameras can share a semantic shot list
lesson.why: The inner 2D camera moves across an unchanged drawing while the outer 3D camera makes a restrained device movement. Both derive their durations from move plus hold in the same shot data.
lesson.experiment: Compare Gallery stroll and Express tour. Check that the inner explanation and outer movement change pace together.
lesson.pitfall: Independent duration constants let nested cameras drift apart even when they begin together.
lesson.combine: Combine with Film chapters when the continuous shot must sit inside a longer narrative.
